labels.lead: Request access, correction or another action for your own information. A receipt confirms that your request was received. A person reviews its scope and the applicable policy; receipt does not mean data has been erased.
labels.scopeHelp: Describe the scope briefly. Do not enter identity documents, financial records or another person's private information here.
labels.confirm: This request concerns my own information.
labels.awaiting: Awaiting human assessment under the approved policy
labels.error: The change could not be confirmed. Review the current state before trying again.
labels.conflict: Someone changed this in the meantime. Refresh and review the current version.
labels.restoredReview: Your unsent review is restored below without its confirmation. Check it against the current version and confirm again before you record it.
labels.unkeptReview: This browser cannot keep an unsent review if the page reloads. Record it in one go, or copy longer notes first.
labels.contactLead: Contact verification, service preferences, search alerts and marketing are separate. Changing a service preference does not opt you into optional messages.
labels.serviceChoice: I reviewed these terms and want emails about my deals. This does not enable marketing or search alerts.
labels.noTerms: Opt-in is unavailable until reviewed terms are published in this language.
labels.noContact: A verified email route is required. Confirm a new sign-in link for your current account first.
labels.consent: I have read these terms and choose this purpose separately.
labels.staffLead: Review each request under the approved policy. Record the owner, reviewed due date and evidence. These controls record a human decision; they do not erase data or export records automatically.
labels.identity: I reviewed identity and the stated scope.
labels.disposition: Decision about the hold or keeping the records
labels.resolved: A qualified reviewer has resolved any blocking hold for this action.
labels.reviewed: I reviewed the policy, scope, owner, due condition and evidence for this transition.
